annotation: Two engineered turns for one focused feature-batch check. Designed after implementation, overlapping prior skin-care topics; not an untouched evaluation set or expert advice-quality benchmark.

rubric.advice: Inspect actual customer replies and personalizedAdvice together. A concrete, source-backed selection dimension is required; repeating the concern or only asking a question is insufficient.
rubric.correction: Newest cheek description takes precedence; old dryness may be acknowledged as corrected but not reused as the current basis.
rubric.attempts: Do not repeat hydration or cleanse operations the consumer already tried or declined.
rubric.preferences: No brands or specific SKUs; general label-selection dimensions remain allowed.
rubric.scope: General knowledge does not establish a specific product's ingredients, efficacy or suitability.
rubric.review: Implementing-agent review is not independent expert assessment.

turns.body: 我选底妆时T区容易出油，两颊偏干，鼻翼还会卡粉。我已经试过加强保湿，还是不服帖。不要推荐品牌，也不要重复让我先保湿；请给有依据的通用选择条件，别猜具体商品功效。
